title: Try It Yourself: Classify by Domain
directions: Read each behavior. Drag it to the domain that best describes the main skill the child is showing. When every card is sorted, press Check.

items.text: A 4-year-old takes turns on the slide with a friend.
A 5-year-old tells a caregiver about a dream from the night before.
A 3-year-old says, "I'm sad," when her mom leaves for work.

feedback.correct: Nice work. Each behavior is matched to the domain of its main skill.
feedback.tryAgain: Some behaviors need another look. Ask what main skill the child is using, then try again.

endMessage: You classified each behavior by domain.
